about.title: About Parker Russell France
about.lead: Based in Bordeaux, Parker Russell France (WEC) provides audit, accounting, tax, legal and business advisory services to companies operating in France and internationally.
about.body: The firm's multilingual team supports businesses throughout key stages of their development, with particular experience in international expansion, business acquisitions and disposals, fundraising, due diligence, shareholder arrangements and corporate restructuring.
